name: Metallic-material combustion property database
description: Literature-curated combustion and ignition data for pure metals and alloys with composition, specimen and atmosphere metadata.
count_scope: Literature descriptor reports 725 composition/property/experimental-condition/reference records across six worksheets; not 725 distinct alloys

sources.title: Metal combustion Scientific Data descriptor
sources.evidence: Reports 725 curated data points from 45 publications and defines a record by composition, property, test condition and reference.

sources.title: Combustion data deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Version 3 contains Combustion_Data.xlsx and explicitly reports CC BY 4.0.

caveats: No atomic crystal coordinates are asserted; the materials are composition-level metal/alloy samples.
Metric units and conditions differ; specimen geometry, test method and oxygen pressure must remain associated with each measurement.
725 is descriptor-reported; workbook rows were not independently recounted.

name: ML-HydPARK metal-hydride storage properties
description: Curated HydPARK-derived metal-hydride compositions, hydrogen capacities and thermodynamic descriptors.
count_scope: ML-HYDPARK_v0.0.5.csv contains 772 data rows; not independently deduplicated crystal structures

sources.title: ML-HydPARK version 0.0.5 deposit
sources.evidence: Deposit identifies a curated HydPARK-derived CSV, version 0.0.5 (2024-02-19), and CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Independent CSV row count
sources.evidence: Parsed the complete 100,494-byte CSV: 772 data rows after the header. The receipt records its SHA-256 and column names.

caveats: A composition table; crystal coordinates are not included.
Experimental source measurements and derived equilibrium-pressure descriptors coexist; label coverage is incomplete.
HydPARK parent data and newer hydrogen databases may overlap. The concept-record URL 7293044 resolved to this version; counts are pinned to v0.0.5.
